description: Source code defining multiple internal classes that implement generic Orleans grain interfaces with various type parameters, including methods for setting and transforming internal state.

classes.name: ConcreteGrainWithGenericInterfaceOfIntFloat
classes.description: Implements IGenericGrain with int and float type parameters, providing methods to set an integer state and map it to float.

classes.name: ConcreteGrainWithGenericInterfaceOfFloatString
classes.description: Implements IGenericGrain with float and string type parameters, providing methods to set a float state and map it to string.

classes.name: ConcreteGrainWith2GenericInterfaces
classes.description: Implements multiple interfaces, managing internal state and providing methods for setting, transforming, retrieving, and comparing grain references.

methods.name: SetT
methods.description: Sets the internal state T for generic grains with int or float.

methods.name: MapT2U
methods.description: Maps internal state T to another type (float or string).

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets the internal state T (delegates to SetT).

methods.name: Transform
methods.description: Transforms the internal state T by multiplying by 10.
